# Rachit Mangawa

> Software Engineer specializing in low-latency systems, AI retrieval pipelines, and web interfaces. CSAI at Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), former Software Developer Intern at UIDAI (Aadhaar). LeetCode Knight (1987, Top 2.84%), Codeforces Specialist (1422), TensorFlow Core upstream contributor.

## Flagship Systems & Projects

- [HeartFlow OS](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/HEARTFLOW_OS/): Deterministic edge AI telemetry system and C99 embedded transpiler. Compiles 5-model Scikit-Learn soft-voting ensembles into zero-malloc C99 headers (<512B stack, 8.15KB SRAM) for microcontrollers. Delivers 18.4µs on-device inference with -76.4% INT8 SRAM reduction.
- [HF Pluggable Gateway](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/hf-backend/): Sub-100ms API aggregation gateway hosting isolated Python subprojects in Docker on Hugging Face Spaces with build-time model prefetching and fault isolation.
- [Semantic Comment Analyzer](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/Semantic-Comment-Analyze/): Dense vector intent classification engine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + L2 logistic head) delivering sub-15ms CPU latency with exact word-level token occlusion explainability and constant 45MB RAM streaming.
- [Vera AI Engine](https://github.com/rachit-mangawa/vera-engine): 4-tier fail-fast AI orchestrator cascade (NVIDIA NIM -> Groq -> Gemini -> Local Qwen SLM via llama-cpp-python with strict LlamaGrammar enforcement) with sub-millisecond context distillation for the magicpin Vera AI Challenge.

## Upstream Open Source

- [TensorFlow Core](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/120944): Numerical autodiff gradient limit fix in tf.math.bessel_i1 at x=0 (Merged PR #120944, Issue #120578) with unit regression tests covering both bessel_i1 and bessel_i1e across TensorFlow Python and C++ bindings.

## Professional Experience

- [UIDAI (Aadhaar) - Software Developer Intern](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/#experience): Built an air-gapped multilingual document ingestion pipeline across 12 Indian languages using OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, local Ollama inference, and hybrid FAISS + BM25 retrieval with Cross-Encoder reranking. Engineered async ETL pipeline streaming 100K-row workbooks in 5–15s via SQLite WAL batch upserts across 4.2M records.
